svg.title: FPGA serial link configuration and clock
svg.text: ENER / FPGA SERIAL LINK CONFIGURATION AND CLOCK
FHE + NEUROMORPHIC RELAY | REFERENCE DESIGN B | 2026-09-05
Schematic design and simulated logic; PCB and assembled hardware not validated.
SPI0 is reserved for this point-to-point peripheral. Runtime mode 0, 1 MHz maximum.
Y1 drives the global-clock-capable pad 35 through R5. The internal PLL is unused.
CRESET_N is wired-OR: U7, SW1 and Pi GPIO17 can pull low. Pi drives low or releases to input; never drives high.
